task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the satellite_disposal_spec.txt file on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/Desktop/satellite_disposal_spec.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a GMAT script at the specified path with Earth gravity and drag models.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT interface or text editor showing a script being saved to ~/GMAT_output/targeted_reentry.script containing 'GravityField' and 'DragForce' configurations.

task_completion.description: Agent configures a retrograde ImpulsiveBurn maneuver in GMAT.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'ImpulsiveBurn' resource window or script text showing a negative Delta-V component (usually in the V direction of the VNB frame).

task_completion.description: Agent executes the GMAT script to model the reentry trajectory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT 'Run' button being pressed or the 'Mission Tree' showing execution progress/completion.

task_completion.description: Agent generates the reentry_trajectory.txt report with the required four columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file at ~/GMAT_output/reentry_trajectory.txt containing columns for ElapsedDays, Altitude, Latitude, and Longitude.

task_completion.description: Agent generates the disposal_summary.txt with DeltaV, Reentry_Latitude, and Reentry_Longitude within SPOUA bounds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file at ~/GMAT_output/disposal_summary.txt showing Latitude between -55.0 and -35.0 and Longitude between 220.0 and 250.0.

integrity.description: Agent uses the GMAT graphical interface rather than just writing text files manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the GMAT application window active and being interacted with.

integrity.description: Agent does not simply echo the target coordinates into a file without running a simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory report file should contain many rows of data, indicating a numerical integration was performed.

integrity.description: Agent logs in using the provided credentials if prompted.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal or login prompt showing 'ga' and 'password123' being entered.
